# Sleep time (`power.sleep_timeout`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Power · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Sets how long before the computer sleeps when idle, on the active power plan.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `minutes` | whole number (≥ 0) | yes |  | Minutes of inactivity; 0 means never. |
| `power_source` | one of: `both`, `ac`, `battery` | no | `both` | Change the setting for ac (plugged in), battery, or both. |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: power.sleep_timeout
    minutes: 0
    power_source: ac
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `power_source` is the same.
